name: StormyLand 101 Anarchy
description:
StormyLand Network is a Bedrock/Java crossplay anarchy network with no rules, make friends, gather resources, and have fun.

This is a Java/Bedrock Crossplay Server.

The Server is still running as of October of 2023, and the map is over 4 years old and is over 30 GB in size, No Rules, No Resets... EVER. To ensure that we make weekly backups to a separate drive.

This is an anarchy server, so hacking is allowed, but we try to keep this server as vanilla as possible. This includes implementing plugins that remove illegally stacked or enchanted items, unobtainable blocks, and anything that may be too overpowered. Everything that is included in vanilla Minecraft can be done on this server. This server used to run on the official BDS and the map was converted over, so you may find some illegal portals, items, or blocks around spawn. The plugin should remove these.

-CONSOLES-

(PS4/PS5, Xbox, and Switch)

Add "SL101Anarchy" as a friend on Xbox live and the server will be visible under "Joinable Friends".

(No need to add an external server.) 

This method of joining is not limited to consoles and can be done on any bedrock platform. This method allows you to invite friends to the server and the server will be joinable from all your devices.

-JAVA EDITION-

IP: anarchy.stormyland.org

Port: 25565

We are always looking for feedback, feel free to share your ideas or report any issues in the Discord server.

Subdomain Provided by FreeDNS(freedns.afraid.org)
